seoTitle: IT Consulting, Cybersecurity, AI & Managed Services
metaDescription: Victrix is the IT, cybersecurity, AI, managed services, cloud and custom application development consultancy for the public and private sectors.

sections.title: Accelerate Your Organization with IT Engineered for What's Next.
sections.subtitle: Turn technology challenges into solutions built to last. From cybersecurity to AI, with cloud, managed services and application services along the way, Victrix takes charge of what drives you forward.
sections.lead: Improve your cybersecurity and optimize your processes with Victrix. Benefit from our industry-leading expertise in managed IT, cloud, and AI governance to drive your business and stay at the technological forefront of your industry.

sections.intro: Complementary IT services that work together or stand alone, covering all of your technology needs.

items.title: Cybersecurity
items.description: Protect your digital assets and prove regulatory compliance.

items.title: AI and Automation
items.description: Put AI to work in your business processes, within a clear governance framework: exploration and analysis of opportunities, development of custom AI agents and solutions, secure adoption of generative AI.

items.title: Cloud
items.description: Modernize your infrastructure and scale your cloud environments at your own pace: multi-cloud roadmap, opportunity study (IaaS, PaaS, SaaS), security posture analysis, migration to a cloud platform (AWS, Azure).

items.title: Application Services
items.description: Build, modernize and maintain the applications that run your operations.

items.title: Managed Services
items.description: Simplify day-to-day IT management with support available around the clock.

sections.title: Free Your Team from Day-to-Day Operations
sections.body: Your team focus on what moves the business forward. Our experts handle performance and uptime.
sections.statText: Proactive support and end-to-end management of your IT environments.

items.title: Ø Studio
items.text: Ø Studio is Victrix's application development studio, specializing in Power Platform and Dynamics 365. Its multidisciplinary team automates your processes and delivers your applications, turnkey or custom-built, at full speed.

items.title: SEvOC
items.text: A traditional SOC hands you alerts and stops there. SEvOC takes them off your hands and keeps your security posture improving, backed by dedicated bilingual analysts and our infrastructure and cloud teams. Unlike a traditional SOC, our scalable and modular offering allows you to remain at the forefront of security technologies.

items.title: Azure Migration
items.text: Victrix accelerates your move to Azure. Our methodology, grounded in Microsoft's Cloud Adoption Framework, de-risks every stage of migrating your application and servers.
